meta.name: cirq
meta.description: Google quantum computing framework. Use when targeting Google Quantum AI hardware, designing noise-aware circuits, or running quantum characterization experiments. Best for Google hardware, noise modeling, and low-level circuit design. For IBM hardware use qiskit; for quantum ML with autodiff use pennylane; for physics simulations use qutip.

copy.tagline: 设计低噪声量子电路,并在谷歌量子处理器上运行实验
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在量子计算领域做研发,需要设计面向谷歌量子芯片的自定义电路。
copy.tagline_en: Build noise-resilient quantum circuits and run experiments on Google quantum hardware.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're researching quantum and need to run custom circuits on Google chips.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在你要求时使用 Cirq 框架：用 Python 构建量子电路、用模拟器运行、施加噪声模型，并可对接谷歌等量子后端做实验。
howto.when: 当任务涉及 Google 量子 AI 硬件、设计考虑噪声的电路，或运行量子表征实验时触发。

say.text: 用 Cirq 画一个贝尔态电路并跑 1000 次模拟。
say.note: 会生成 Cirq 代码并展示直方图。

say.text: 把 theta 从 0 到 2π 扫 20 个点，运行参数电路。
say.note: 会做参数扫描并打印各点结果。

say.text: 给电路加 0.01 的退极化噪声，模拟并对比输出。
say.note: 会构建噪声电路并比较输出。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude uses the Cirq framework to build quantum circuits in Python, run them on simulators, apply noise models, and help connect to Google and other quantum backends when you ask for it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the task targets Google Quantum AI hardware, involves noise-aware circuit design, or asks for quantum characterization experiments.

say_en.text: Use Cirq to make a Bell-state circuit and run 1000 simulations.
say_en.note: Generates Cirq code and shows the histogram.

say_en.text: Sweep theta from 0 to 2π over 20 points for the parameterized circuit.
say_en.note: Runs a parameter sweep and prints each result.

say_en.text: Add 0.01 depolarizing noise to the circuit, simulate it, and compare outputs.
say_en.note: Builds a noisy circuit and compares output.
